clips.title: The story
paras: In Stranglethorn Vale, the master smith Galvan the Ancient works to fashion specialized armament capable of striking down powerful demons. This forging provides an enchanted weapon imbued with the Felcurse, designed specifically to weaken Razelikh the Defiler and his servitors.

Galvan the Ancient requires patience while he works his craft just south of the path leading into Zul'Gurub. Rushing the forging risks creating a flawed blade, staff, or dagger. Once completed, the chosen weapon carries the power of the Felcurse, which can be unleashed periodically to weaken Razelikh the Defiler and his demonic underlings. The duration of this debilitating curse can vary.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Friend, the creation of each weapon will take some time.

Additionally, you may only use the power of the Felcurse once per three minutes. Its weakening properties against Razelikh the Defiler and his minions may be variable in duration. This is why you must release the Felcurse only when the moment is right!
Now give me a moment to craft your weapon, friend.

clips.title: Progress
paras: To interrupt the forging process could result in an imperfect weapon. Be patient, friend.

clips.title: Completion
paras: A finer demon slayer has never existed, friend.
